effort.description: Story-worker effort per tier, and the story-reviewer's. A project's own setting in .epikloop/project.json wins over this one.

model.description: Models the user chooses. This setting wins over a project's own in .epikloop/project.json, since an account decides which models it has.

harbor.description: Whether Harbor runs. Off means no Harbor process exists.

model.description: A model's name as the Agent tool takes one, such as fable or opus. `design` is the model that draws a design's directions and screens.
